evidence.claim: The Luanda mini-summit produced a ceasefire to take effect on 25 November and required M23 to withdraw from occupied areas in the DRC.
evidence.title: Le mini-sommet de Luanda impose au m23/Rwanda un cessez-le-feu et le retrait des zones occupées en RDC
evidence.excerpt: The Luanda mini-summit produced a ceasefire to take effect on 25 November and required M23 to withdraw from occupied areas in the DRC.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidency communiqué on a dated regional agreement in which Tshisekedi participated.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly tied to Tshisekedi's participation in a regional settlement effort.
contrary_evidence: Agreement terms do not establish compliance or long-term peace.

evidence.claim: Tshisekedi said M23 had to stop hostilities, withdraw from its positions, and return to its November 2021 lines as a condition for joining the Nairobi peace process.
evidence.title: Troisième phase des pourparlers de Nairobi : Les chefs d’Etats appellent les groupes armés à déposer les armes
evidence.excerpt: Tshisekedi said M23 had to stop hostilities, withdraw from its positions, and return to its November 2021 lines as a condition for joining the Nairobi peace process.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct quotation of Tshisekedi in contemporaneous local-language reporting on the Nairobi process.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 ruler statement during peace negotiations
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly Tshisekedi's own public peace-process position.
contrary_evidence: This is a stated condition for talks, not proof that the condition was enforceable.

evidence.claim: Human Rights Watch said M23 summarily killed at least 29 civilians since mid-June 2022 and expanded control in the east, documenting deliberate civilian harm by the rebels.
evidence.title: DR Congo: Resurgent M23 Rebels Target Civilians
evidence.excerpt: Human Rights Watch said M23 summarily killed at least 29 civilians since mid-June 2022 and expanded control in the east, documenting deliberate civilian harm by the rebels.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Well-documented independent human-rights report based on field reporting and interviews.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirectly relevant to Tshisekedi's security environment and proxy-control problem.
contrary_evidence: The source is about M23 conduct, not direct acts by Tshisekedi.

evidence.claim: The article said since November 2021 the M23 fighting had killed hundreds and forced nearly 200,000 people from their homes and land, separating families across Rutshuru.
evidence.title: I prayed to God to find him: the families scattered by violence in DRC
evidence.excerpt: The article said since November 2021 the M23 fighting had killed hundreds and forced nearly 200,000 people from their homes and land, separating families across Rutshuru.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent reporting with a direct displacement estimate and year-specific conflict timeline.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Context for Tshisekedi's conflict-handling choices and civilian-protection record.
contrary_evidence: It is reportorial context, not a legal or official finding.

evidence.claim: AP reported that UN experts had solid evidence that members of Rwanda's armed forces were operating in eastern Congo in support of M23, which was driving deaths and massive civilian displacement.
evidence.title: UN experts: Rwandan forces operate with M23 rebels in Congo
evidence.excerpt: AP reported that UN experts had solid evidence that members of Rwanda's armed forces were operating in eastern Congo in support of M23, which was driving deaths and massive civilian displacement.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: AP wire report summarizing a confidential UN expert finding with precise attribution and consequences.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirectly relevant to Tshisekedi's conflict environment and claims about external support.
contrary_evidence: This does not prove Tshisekedi's own conduct; it supports the external-aggression context.

evidence.claim: At the UN General Assembly, Tshisekedi said Rwanda's involvement and responsibility in the tragedy in areas occupied by the Rwandan army and its M23 allies were no longer questionable.
evidence.title: Congo crisis in focus at UN General Assembly
evidence.excerpt: At the UN General Assembly, Tshisekedi said Rwanda's involvement and responsibility in the tragedy in areas occupied by the Rwandan army and its M23 allies were no longer questionable.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent reporting of a ruler statement at a dated multilateral forum.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly Tshisekedi's public narrative about the conflict.
contrary_evidence: This records Tshisekedi's accusation, not independent proof that the accusation was fully correct.

evidence.claim: The presidency said Tshisekedi issued ordinances reshuffling the FARDC command, including naming Christian Tshiwewe as chief of staff, as part of military reform.
evidence.title: Profonds changements au commandement de l'armée : Tshiwewe a l'état-major général Fardc et Ephraïm Kabi à la garde républicaine
evidence.excerpt: The presidency said Tshisekedi issued ordinances reshuffling the FARDC command, including naming Christian Tshiwewe as chief of staff, as part of military reform.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary announcement of personnel changes in the armed forces made under presidential authority.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Tshisekedi's formal authority over military appointments.
contrary_evidence: A personnel reshuffle does not by itself show better battlefield performance or accountability.

unresolved_gaps: No direct 2022 nuclear/existential-risk decision by Tshisekedi is evidenced, and the package never shows operational nuclear control, brinkmanship, or safeguard intervention.
Direct 2022 execution and household/distribution outcome evidence remains thinner than the policy and macro coverage.
Direct, nationally representative 2022 welfare-outcome evidence attributable to Tshisekedi remains limited relative to the amount of partner-led program evidence.

Direct personal-nexus evidence is still sparse: no clear 2022 asset-declaration, campaign-finance, beneficial-ownership, or court/audit record ties Tshisekedi himself to self-dealing or deliberate deception.
Independent, audited delivery and outcome evidence is thinner than the program rhetoric and internal reporting.
